verdict.rationale: Glama's docs say developers can search, compare, and inspect the capabilities of thousands of MCP servers in a curated catalog, and a probe of llms.txt confirms a directory of 91,626 servers and 23,749 remote connectors. The browser inspector also lets developers test a server before wiring it into an agent. Missing for 10: documentation of capability-based filtering or facets in search, and independent hands-on reports on search quality (one community comment notes it is easy to get lost in the large catalog).

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent
